svg.title: @tg.jit horizontal fusion
svg.desc: Two WeightedSum leaves read the same CSR graph and feature vector x with different edge weights; @tg.jit captures both as SSA leaves and fuses both reducers into a single kernel launch that returns both outputs.
svg.text: Two leaves on one graph, one fused kernel launch
explain() reports applies=2, post_fusion=1 — both reducers in a single pass over the edges
